title: 第6章 上门找茬
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你先跟我来吧。”

沉默了一会儿，沈哥站起身，推门带他离开三小姐的院子。

寨子里还弥漫着大火后的焦糊味，几个喽啰正拎着水桶清理残骸，看见林珝出来，纷纷停下手里的活计，眼神各异。

沈哥没理会那些目光，领着林珝穿过寨子中央的土路，走向一排低矮的木屋。

“进去吧。”沈哥推开其中一间房门，把钥匙丢给林珝。

林珝推门进去，房间很小，一张木板床、一张矮桌、一个缺了角的木柜，陈设简陋得不能再简陋。

好歹地面扫得很干净，没有蛛网，也没有那股子沤烂稻草的霉味。

“柴房烧了，不能住人，小姐让你搬这儿。”沈哥指了指房间，平静地转身离开。

直到他走远，林珝才默默把门关上。

终于不用住那种四面漏风的破屋子了。

林珝把自己摔在木板床上，肩膀的箭创被牵得一疼，他龇了龇牙，却没有动弹。

虎口还残留着昨晚握刀时磨出的红痕，林珝张开五指，闭上眼，乌勒斥候临死前暴凸的眼珠又浮了上来。

刀刃切入皮肉的顿感，以及热血喷在脸上的温度，让他久久无法平静。

这里，已经不在再是他熟悉的那个和平年代。

“呼！”

缓了好久，林珝才攥紧拳头，硬生生把那股生理性的颤抖压了下去。

换了个住处，听起来是好事。

但林珝心里清楚，这屋子离三小姐的院子不远，说是换个房间，难说不是另一种方式的囚禁。

窗没锁，门没关，但那个沈哥依旧在不远处，半夜出门撒尿都能碰上面。

“算了，既来之则安之吧。”

不知不觉，天快亮了。

林珝叹了口气，迷迷糊糊合上眼，刚要睡过去，院门被砰一声，被人一脚踹开。

撞击声让他一个激灵坐起来，看见几个五大三粗的人正蛮横地差闯进房间。

为首的是个大光头，满脸横肉，太阳穴上一条旧刀疤一直拉到耳根，看着就不好惹。

林珝认出了这个家伙，好像叫老光。

在山寨里有点名气，虽然不是头目，但手底下聚了七八个弟兄，打架斗狠从不手软。

更要紧的是，他跟昨晚那个疤哥，关系好像不简单。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"You come with me first."

After a moment of silence, Brother Shen stood up, pushed the door open and took him out of the third lady's yard.

The stockade was still filled with the burnt smell after the fire. Several minions were carrying buckets to clean up the wreckage. When they saw Lin Jue coming out, they all stopped what they were doing and looked at each other with different expressions.

Brother Shen ignored those glances and led Lin Jue through the dirt road in the center of the village towards a row of low wooden houses.

"Go in." Brother Shen opened one of the doors and threw the key to Lin Jue.

Lin Jue pushed the door open and went in. The room was very small, with a wooden bed, a low table, and a wooden cabinet with a corner missing. The furnishings could not be more basic.

At least the floor was swept clean, with no cobwebs or the musty smell of rotten straw.

"The woodshed is burned down and cannot be inhabited. The lady asked you to move here." Brother Shen pointed to the room and calmly turned around and left.

It wasn't until he walked away that Lin Jue silently closed the door.

Finally, we no longer have to live in a dilapidated house with drafts from all sides.

Lin Jue threw himself on the wooden bed. The arrow wound on his shoulder was painful. He bared his teeth but did not move.

The tiger's mouth still had red marks from the time he held the knife last night. Lin Sui spread his fingers and closed his eyes. Scout Ule's bulging eyes came up again before he died.

The sudden feeling of the blade cutting into the flesh and the warmth of the hot blood spraying on his face made him unable to calm down for a long time.

This place is no longer the peaceful era he was familiar with.

"Phew!"

After waiting for a long time, Lin Jue clenched her fists and suppressed the physiological tremor.

Changing residence sounds like a good thing.

But Lin Jue knew in her heart that this house was not far from the third lady's yard. It was just a change of rooms, but it was not another form of imprisonment.

The window was unlocked and the door was not closed, but Brother Shen was still not far away, and he could touch it when he went out to urinate in the middle of the night.

"Forget it, let's make peace with it now that we've come."

Before I knew it, it was getting dark.

Lin Jue sighed and closed her eyes in a daze. Just as she was about to fall asleep, the door to the courtyard was banged and someone kicked it open.

The sound of the impact made him sit up in excitement, and he saw several tall and thick-looking people barging into the room arrogantly.

The leader was a bald man with a slender face and an old scar on his temple that stretched to the base of his ear.

Lin Jue recognized this guy, his name seemed to be Lao Guang.

He is somewhat famous in the village. Although he is not the leader, he has seven or eight brothers under him, and he never shows mercy in fights.

What's more important is that his relationship with Brother Scar last night doesn't seem to be simple.
